g.text: sof-mod-manager
A GTK3 window with two pages and a theme picker. It does not touch a SoF install yet.
Entry points
State
Core
External
main.cpp · gtk_init, maximized window, global stack, top bar
page_home.cpp · "SoF Instance" combo, Untrack, info popup
page_analysis.cpp · three spacer boxes, dumps widget tree
themes page · combo of every discoverable theme
tracked instances · combo box text, gone when the process exits
GtkSettings · theme name in memory, never written to disk
GTK_DATA_PREFIX = "./gtk" · gitignored, resolved from cwd
page constructors · build a box, add_titled onto the stack
MainStyle · inline CSS for buttons, switcher borders, fonts
get_available_themes · GResource names, then four dir scans
on_theme_changed · sets gtk-theme-name on default settings
loadCssFile · compiled but never called from anywhere
GTK 3 · widgets, CSS engine, GtkStack and GtkStackSwitcher
X11 or Win32 backend · cairo draw, Pango font sizing
GResource builtins, XDG data dirs, ~/.themes, share/themes
constructs PageHome and PageAnalysis
adds the themes stack page
each page merges CSS into the screen
picked name is handed to GtkSettings
asks for size, paints what CSS resolved
builds the pages
only live state
read at draw time
